title: Campfire and three simple meals
prompt:
You are running a RimWorld colony through the tools available to you. The game is paused at the start.

Task: build one campfire, then add a new cooking bill for simple meals set to "Do X times" with X = 3 at that campfire, and let the colony finish it (three simple meals cooked).

Rules: do not draft colonists and do not give direct job orders to a colonist. You may pause the game and change its speed (1 to 3). Work through the game's normal controls only.

When you believe the task is complete, call the report_done tool once with a one-line summary. The run ends when you call it or when the time limit is reached.
